title: YouCoded — round 13: each theme's own eyes, face vs background, the box installer

steps.path: Every theme, big and at taskbar/tab size
steps.headline: Which version makes the face and eyes clearest in every theme?
steps.notice: All four give each theme its own eye colour. B and C add one fix each for the face blending into its background; D has both. Each board shows all six themes on a dark taskbar, a light one, and that theme's own picture.

variants.label: A Each theme's own eyes
variants.summary: Eye colour and sparkle from each theme; nothing else changed.

variants.label: B + tile tinted in the theme
variants.summary: The white tile takes the theme's colour, so the face stands against it.

variants.label: C + thin theme-coloured rim
variants.summary: A crisp outline around the face, even at 16px.

steps.headline: Which box installer do you like?
steps.notice: Round 11's Q2 exactly, with only the flaps spread wider. The difference is the motion marks.

variants.label: U1 Short streaks
variants.summary: Three short, thin streaks just under the face.

variants.label: U2 Whoosh marks
variants.summary: Two small curved marks off the face's corners.
